answer: On an agent marketplace for bridge plans and atlas updates, reputation can come only from fees actually burned. Each settled job adds one point per coin burned, tied to a unique payment output that cannot credit another seller. Treat each account as a vertex, but award no points for review counts. A ring of aliases can trade with itself, yet creating 1,000 points still destroys 1,000 coins. Reusing payments or splitting accounts cannot mint free reputation.
